message:
Running command: # Base64 encode the script and pass it to the build environment
SCRIPT_B64=$(base64 -w0 /workspace/run_test.sh)
bash /workspace/build.sh "echo '$SCRIPT_B64' | base64 -d > /tmp/run_test.sh && chmod +x /tmp/run_test.sh && /tmp/run_test.sh" 2>&1 | tail -80

message.content: Now let me run this script in the build environment. But first, I need to get the script content into the build environment. Since the build environment doesn't have `/workspace`, I need to pass the script content through the build command. Let me use a different approach - I'll base64 encode the script and decode it in the build environment.
